notes: Rates come from each provider's pricing page on the date each model was checked; check them before spending. Batch and synchronous rates are separate. Where a provider's pages do not say whether the batch discount and the cache prices stack, the batch card carries the higher (unstacked) cache rate until the pricing test against the billed figure settles it. Prompts above a provider's long-prompt threshold (Anthropic 100K, OpenAI 272K input tokens) are billed at higher rates that this table does not model.

claude-haiku-5-5.note: cache_write is the 1-hour rate (5 minutes: 0.125); batch cache rates are the unstacked ones (50% off would give 0.10 and 0.005); above 100K prompt tokens the page lists 0.50 in / 2.50 out

claude-sonnet-5-5.note: cache_write is the 1-hour rate (5 minutes: 2.50); batch cache rates are the unstacked ones

gpt-6-luna.note: the page says Batch is 50% of Standard, which would make cached input 0.005; 0.01 is used until the pricing test settles it; no cache write price is listed, so input-rate is used; above 272K input tokens the page lists 2x input and cache rates and 1.5x output

gpt-6.1-sol.note: batch cached input is the unstacked 0.10 (50% off would give 0.05); no cache write price is listed, so the input rate is used; above 272K input tokens the page lists 2x input and cache rates and 1.5x output

gemini-3.8-flash.note: introductory rate until 2026-12-31; the page lists one input rate, so cached tokens are priced at it (an upper bound); context-cache storage is billed separately and is not counted here

then.note: list rate after the introductory period

gemini-4-argon.note: introductory rate until 2026-11-30; cached tokens are priced at the input rate (an upper bound)

then.note: list rate after the introductory period

deepseek-flash.note: no batch API; peak is Mon-Fri 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC (double price); the page does not name the currency; the cache is automatic and a miss is billed as plain input

deepseek-v4-pro.note: text only; no batch API; peak hours as for deepseek-flash
